verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a robotics simulation platform, such as batch-editing assets or acting on many prims or robots at once. The evidence pack never documents such a capability. Standalone Python scripting and 'automate workflows' are developer building blocks for building bulk actions, not a bulk-operation feature. Large-scale GPU training is about training scale, not acting on many items at once, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
